description:
v1.0 | 141 gates | 4 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Sends one of 64 data lines to the output.

Use this to read one of several sources through a single output, chosen by a number, such as passing on one of many sensor readings, or choosing which of several stored values reaches a display.

The data inputs come first, followed by the number that selects one of them, with its lowest value input first. The single output carries the chosen data input.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): data lines = x 0-63, line number = x 64-69.
Outputs (green gates): the chosen line = x 0.

Profile: small, the build with the fewest gates for this size.
How it works: One wide gate per term: gates take any number of inputs, so no stages are needed.
Checked on about a million inputs in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.
By: byggmesterPRO
